description: This file contains utility functions for reading and processing HTTP response streams with timeout and size limits, including functions to read response prefixes, handle overflow, and generate text snippets.

methods.name: readChunkWithIdleTimeout
methods.description: Reads a chunk from a stream with an idle timeout, cancelling the reader if timeout occurs.

methods.name: readResponsePrefix
methods.description: Reads a prefix of the response body up to a maximum byte size, with optional timeout handling.

methods.name: readResponseWithLimit
methods.description: Reads response data up to a maximum byte size, throwing an error if content exceeds limit.

methods.name: readResponseTextSnippet
methods.description: Extracts a text snippet from the response, with size and character limits, handling timeouts.
